shots.title: Keep your flow
shots.voice: Dictation should fit the way you work.
shots.action: Browser, Ghostty and Herdr share a real Omarchy desktop. The film starts in an actual working environment.
shots.motion: Keep the desktop still for one beat, then introduce the recorder. Real VM capture; no invented shell.

shots.title: Meet Mluva
shots.voice: Meet Mluva, most delightful dictation app for Omarchy.
shots.action: Final glossy red mark, the Mluva wordmark and one clear promise.
shots.motion: Calm lockup reveal over the licensed water loop. Reuse the Brand masters.

shots.title: Choose providers
shots.action: Welcome presents speech and rewrite provider/model choices. Continue into the app.
shots.motion: Show first-run setup, then the Providers route. Settings fills the window.

shots.title: F9. Talk. F9. Paste.
shots.action: Press F9 to start and stop. Text wraps continuously, then arrives in the previously focused editor.
shots.motion: Automatic pasting enabled. Show exact source text and the real target; no sentence-by-sentence line breaks.

shots.title: Float, tile, open
shots.voice: Omarchy moves like water. Tile it, or let it float.
shots.action: Move the same Mluva window between floating and tiled states; keep surrounding apps filled.
shots.motion: Use real Omarchy window borders and Super+T. Do not substitute an invented desktop.

shots.title: Edit and find an action
shots.voice: Done talking? Edit it, polish it, rewrite it.
shots.action: Open Ctrl+P, choose Polish text, show the changed words, then return to the finished result.
shots.motion: Speed up the completed result. Speech appears immediately at full opacity. Existing-word corrections may settle upward by 3 px in 180 ms; native GTK replaces them immediately. Keep all unchanged text stable.

shots.title: Return to a note
shots.action: Search history and return to the same note, with its original and revisions retained.
shots.motion: Keep the selected note legible. No new feature claim.

shots.title: Your desktop, your palette
shots.voice: Your desktop, your palette. Any Omarchy theme, automatically.
shots.action: The current Omarchy theme supplies the palette. Demonstrate three examples, including actual window border changes.
shots.motion: Three shown examples are not a support limit. Use real captures plus shared semantic theme modes.

shots.title: Live rewrite
shots.voice: Try Live rewrite. Keep speaking as your text takes shape.
shots.action: Dictate a structured note. Preserve the source and update only changed words in the Markdown draft.
shots.motion: Live rewrite is experimental. No email example. Continuous source wrapping; collapse either pane without data loss.

shots.title: Give the task a shape
shots.voice: Or build a task spec, with questions for what’s still missing.
shots.action: Keep the user's answer visible while the answered question retires and the next useful question appears.
shots.motion: Animate question replacement and append the confirmed requirement. Never erase the answer.

shots.title: A little more delight
shots.voice: A little more delight every day.
shots.action: Return to the same Mluva mark and wordmark. Hold the closing phrase and repository.
shots.motion: Use the shared water background. Keep the final lockup readable for the last beat.

examples.dictation: Could we move the review to Tuesday? I’ll send the draft tomorrow.
examples.polished: Could we reschedule the review for Tuesday? I’ll send the draft tomorrow.
examples.corrected: Could we move the review to Wednesday? I’ll send the draft tomorrow.
examples.sourceWrapping: One continuous paragraph, wrapping by available width.
examples.grillingAnswer: It’s for me, as a file I can keep.
